about_the_game:
Sente is a strategic board game where every player moves at the same time.  
Your victory isn’t about acting first; it’s about thinking ahead.  

Set out on a campaign to outthink your opponent by placing your nodes and spreading your energy network across the board. Try to anticipate your opponent and commit to a strategy that may well change in the next turn. The match ends when either you (or your opponent) outmanouevers the other and make direct connection with their energy core, resulting in a critical overload. Connections spark, systems collapse, and explosive chain reactions reshape the battlefield in an instant.
 
Dig deeper into Sente and you'll find a game that relies on foresight and prediction, resulting in deep consequence with each passing move. 

  • Simultaneous gameplay creates intense mind games every round 

  • Build and disrupt energy networks to take control of the grid 

  • Chain reactions and board control can turn small decisions into dramatic shifts 

  • Dynamic board layouts help to ensure every match feels different and no two games are the same. 

  • Create custom arenas with the in-game board editor and build your own challenges

  • Replay matches to analyse tactics and refine your strategy 

 

Inspired by the clarity of timeless strategy games like Chess and Go, Sente is built on a wholly original ruleset designed with aworld of depth and endless replayability in mind! 

With support for 1–6 players Sente has something for all types of strategy fan. Play solo in fully customisable battles or face off against human opponents in PvP! 

  • Solo play - Challenge multiple levels of increasingly difficult AI opponents or jump into the narrative campaign. 

  • Online and local multiplayer - Compete with friends in 1v1 arenas, or head into Quick Play to take on the world! 

  • Free-for-all or team-based strategy matches - Supporting 1-6 players, expect to not only change the battlefield, but also your strategy! 

  • Strategic puzzle challenges designed to sharpen your strategy as well as your mind.

Each game mode adds new possibilities, and new unpredictable tactical battles for dominance where no two games are (likely) to be the same! Can a human mind still find the winning move when the odds are literally programmed against them?

  • 1–6 Player Strategic Showdowns - Face off on your own against AI, challenge friends locally, or compete online in tactical multiplayer matches.

  • Simultaneous Mind Games - Everyone moves at once. Predict your opponents or watch your plans collapse.

  • Build and Disrupt Energy Networks - Expand across the board, cut enemy connections, and unleash explosive chain reactions.

  • Relive Every Turning Point - Replay matches to analyse your victories and refine your strategies.

  • Design New Battlefields - Create custom boards and discover entirely new strategies with the in-game board editor.

  • Strategic Puzzle Challenges – Push your tactical thinking with curated scenarios designed to test your mastery.

  • Multiple Strategic Game Modes - Jump into quick matches, free-for-all clashes, or coordinated team battles, each mode reshaping how the board is played and the tactics you'll need to bring!
